senses.gloss: m. (part. pass. of לְקַט) pinched out, chiselled, in bass-relief (cmp. Syr. לקטא embroidery, P. Sm. 1970).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 7:19">Targ. I Kings VII, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 7:26">Ib. 26</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 4:5">Targ. II Chr. IV, 5</cite> <he>ל׳ כשושנתא</he> chiselled in the shape of a rose.
